system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Cursor's agent orchestrates these components for each model we support, tuning instructions and tools specifically for every frontier model.
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt plus rules; per-model tuning.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Search for files by name, read directory structures, and find exact keywords or patterns within files.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Control a browser to take screenshots, test applications, and verify visual changes.
observation_format.note: Also image file reading included in context.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: To understand how tool calling works under the hood, see our tool calling fundamentals.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Tools are the building blocks of Agent. They are used to search your codebase and the web to find relevant information, make edits to your files, run terminal commands, and more.
tool_count.note: Counted listed families: file search, web search, fetch rules, read file, edit file, terminal, browser, image generation, ask question — approximate.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Suggest edits to files and apply them automatically.
edit_primitive.note: Edit primitive not specified; closest value.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: There is no limit on the number of tool calls Agent can make during a task.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Use /goal to give the agent a long-lived objective to work towards until it's fully complete
planning_granularity.note: Project coordinator agent plans the work, but no stored plan object described for Agent default.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: For a larger body of work, such as a feature or a migration, create a Project: a coordinator agent plans the work and delegates it to other agents.
multi_agent_topology.note: Default is a single agent; Projects give orchestrator_workers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a coordinator agent plans the work and delegates it to other agents
delegation_mechanism.note: Default Agent has no delegation; Projects reach subagent_spawn.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Ask clarifying questions during a task. While waiting for your response, the agent continues reading files, making edits, or running commands.
human_in_loop.note: Interactive IDE product; user can steer/interrupt mid-run.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: A side chat is a durable agent conversation. It uses the parent thread as hidden reference context and keeps its own transcript.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: or with the built-in /loop skill for recurring check-ins while it pursues the objective
long_term_memory.note: Rules are also retrievable: "Retrieve specific rules based on type and description."

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Checkpoints save snapshots of your codebase during an Agent session. Agent automatically creates them before making significant changes, capturing the state of all modified files.

rollback.evidence_quote: click any checkpoint in the chat timeline to preview your files at that point, then restore to revert all files to that state

termination_condition.evidence_quote: There is no limit on the number of tool calls Agent can make during a task.
termination_condition.note: Explicitly no step cap; user can also interrupt.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Execute terminal commands and monitor output. By default, Cursor uses the first terminal profile available.
execution_isolation.note: Runs in the user's local terminal profile.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Suggest edits to files and apply them automatically.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the local machine boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Generate search queries and perform web searches.

tracing.evidence_quote: Messages appear in order below the active task
tracing.note: Chat timeline/transcript is the only run record described.

replayability.evidence_quote: Restoring a checkpoint reverts files only; it does not remove messages from the conversation.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Tools are the building blocks of Agent.
eval_hooks.note: No evaluation runner mentioned; closed-source product.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Agent is Cursor's assistant that can complete complex coding tasks independently, run terminal commands, and edit code.

open_source.evidence_quote: Cursor's agent orchestrates these components for each model we support
open_source.note: Commercial closed-source product; documentation only, no repo.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Model: The agent model you pick for the task

primary_artifact.note: Coded from vendor documentation; no source repo available.
